newsitem.title: USA: MBIA says will shut briefly on Fri for party.
newsitem.headline: MBIA says will shut briefly on Fri for party.

text.p: MBIA said that it will briefly shut its secondary market insurance department on Friday for a holiday party.
The department will be closed from 1200 EST to 1500 EST that afternoon. MBIA directed its clients to leave a message at 800-624-2669 during that period, in a prepared statement.
